description: Browse every OpenAPI `x-` specification extension harvested across the catalog, with the provenance the OpenAPI Initiative registry does not carry: who publishes it, in how many documents, where in the document it appears, and what shape the value takes. Search by key or purpose; sort by occurrences.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

q.description: Free text matched against name and description, e.g. "payments".

sort.description: Order: occurrences or documents (largest first), or name, e.g. "occurrences".

name: find_extensions
